name: a1-scout
description: Match open models and tools to the work you do in Claude and Codex.
long_description: A1 Scout reads your Claude Code and Codex history on this computer and sends Scout only a summary: which tools, commands, languages, libraries and models you used, with counts and dates. Your prompts, replies, file contents, file paths, project names, web addresses, emails and keys never leave your computer. Ask Claude to "connect me to A1 Scout" to start.

tools.name: connect_scout
tools.description: Connect this computer to A1 Scout with a short code you approve in your browser.

tools.name: scout_status
tools.description: Show the connection and what Scout knows about your work.

tools.name: preview_scout_summary
tools.description: Show exactly what would be sent. Sends nothing.

tools.name: scout_settings
tools.description: Choose what Scout reads and which projects to leave out.

tools.name: disconnect_scout
tools.description: Stop sending and forget this computer's connection.

claude_sessions.title: Claude Code and Cowork history
claude_sessions.description: Read your Claude Code and Cowork sessions on this computer.

codex_sessions.title: Codex history
codex_sessions.description: Read your Codex sessions on this computer.

auto_sync.title: Sync automatically
auto_sync.description: Send new session summaries while Claude is open (at most every 30 minutes).

exclude.title: Projects to leave out
exclude.description: Folder names or patterns, separated by commas, like client-* or private-notes.
